source_title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds 2nd Gen drop $70 on Amazon
source_excerpt:

Bose’s QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) are built for people who care most about blocking out noise and getting a secure, comfortable fit, and there’s a solid deal on them right now. This premium true-wireless pair puts the focus on active noise cancellation, everyday comfort, and useful extras that make them easy to live with.
These earbuds add a few welcome upgrades over the earlier version. Bose says they have improved adaptive ANC behavior, better voice pickup for calls, and wireless charging support. You also get Bluetooth 5.3, multipoint connectivity for switching between devices, app-based customization, and Bose CustomTune sound calibration. Battery life is about six hours per charge, with roughly 24 hours total when you include the charging case.
The fit is another big part of the appeal. Bose uses its eartip-and-stability-band design to help the earbuds stay put while still feeling comfortable, and the newer design also adds small touches like guards to help reduce wax buildup. Sound is described as powerful, polished, and engaging, but these earbuds are especially known for their strong noise canceling and all-day usability.
That’s what makes the current Amazon deal worth a look. The Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) are down to $229, from a $299 RRP. That’s a $70 saving, or 23% off the recommended retail price. This price also matches the lowest price we’ve seen this year, so it’s a good time to grab them if top-tier noise canceling is what you want most. You can check out the deal here .
